title: Ordering Food at a Cafe
description: The learner walks into a small cafe and needs to order a meal, ask about ingredients, and pay.
objectives: Order a food item and a drink
possible_events: The item the learner asks for is sold out and they must choose something else
The server asks if they want anything to drink
The learner is asked for how they'd like to pay
success_criteria: Learner successfully orders at least one food item
Learner responds appropriately when something is unavailable

difficulty_modifiers.description: Server simplifies to short yes/no style questions, e.g. 'Water or coffee?'
Server improvises a complication, e.g. running out of the ordered dish and offering alternatives
